settings.projectFactorySensitivePathsDesc: Globs, separated by commas. A change that touches one is high risk, besides .github/, migrations and auth/
settings.projectFactoryMaxLowRiskLinesDesc: A change with more changed lines than this is high risk. Tests, Markdown, translations, stories, snapshots and lockfiles do not count
settings.projectFactoryApprovalAdjustDesc: After you approve a high-risk change, the factory may merge a later commit that differs from it by at most this many lines, only in files you approved and with no new risk reason. It then merges lines no person read; the review still has to pass. 0: only the same change
settings.projectFactoryHoldPaths: Keep files while waiting for an approval
settings.projectFactoryHoldPathsDesc: While a high-risk change waits for your approval, no other run starts on the files it is expected to touch, for at most 12 hours. Later runs wait longer; approved changes meet fewer conflicts
settings.projectFactorySizeIgnoredPathsDesc: Globs, separated by commas. Their lines do not count toward the size of a change. Sensitive paths still apply to them
settings.projectFactoryStageLimitsDesc: How many runs may be implementing or in review at once. Merges are always one batch at a time per repository
settings.projectFactoryTriggersDesc: Start a flow on a schedule, or once, without an issue. Such a run can open a pull request and never merges one by itself
settings.projectFactoryBatchDesc: Ready pull requests are tested together on the current base and merged as tested, in about one CI run. How many in one batch (1: one at a time), and how long to wait to gather them
settings.projectFactoryReadinessBatches: Ready pull requests merge in batches.
settings.projectFactoryReadinessSerial: Pull requests merge one at a time:
settings.projectFactoryReadinessHostQueue: Pull requests merge through GitHub's merge queue:
settings.projectFactoryDependenciesWaitDesc: An issue waits until its blockers have merged
settings.projectFactoryDependenciesStackDesc: An issue whose blocker has a pull request open starts on the blocker's branch, and merges after it
settings.projectFactoryTooBig: Issues too large for one change
settings.projectFactoryTooBigAskDesc: The factory comments the split triage proposes on the issue, and waits until a person changes the issue
settings.projectFactoryTooBigSplitDesc: The factory opens each part triage proposes as its own issue and works on them; the original issue leaves the factory. A part is never split again by itself
settings.projectFactorySameReviewer: The review step of this flow uses the same provider and model as the implementing agent, so it tends to miss what the implementer missed. Set a different provider or model on the review step of the flow.
settings.projectFactoryStatusDesc: Running: takes the issues you send from the Issues tab. Paused: nothing new starts; queued issues wait
